prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE sharply focused, minimal LAZERS task-panel screenshot, deeply inspired by Linear's actual issue list: quiet dark neutral surfaces, typographic hierarchy, compact rows, almost invisible separators, restrained monochrome status glyphs, one subtly highlighted selected row. The previous concept was rejected for being much too complicated. Start fresh; do not reproduce a dashboard.

Composition: one single square or slightly portrait native side panel, cropped to ONLY the panel contents. No surrounding app shell, sidebar, chat, browser, device frame, canvas, branding, title banner, annotations, or extra screens. The task list occupies the upper half. A single thin horizontal resizable divider separates the selected task's detail below. Everything left aligned on one consistent vertical grid. Readable high fidelity text. The feeling is pure focus and immediate understanding, like Linear at its most restrained.

Header: simply "Tasks" on the left, with a tiny unobtrusive green connection dot. At right only "Active" with small chevron and a search icon. No tabs, no toolbars of pills, no metrics.

Upper list: two understated small muted feature group labels, with spacious separation between groups. Each task row shows ONLY a tiny lifecycle glyph and the task title. No task IDs in list rows, no columns, no table borders, no status words repeated per row, no tags, avatars, badges, chips, progress bars, dependency counts or scheduling text.
Group label "Retry-safe submission":
1. small partially filled running-circle glyph, "Persist submission identity"
2. same running-circle glyph, "Document retry contract"
3. empty-circle glyph, "Test restart recovery" [selected with very subtle neutral-violet row tint, no saturated blue band]
4. empty-circle glyph, "Verify native tool replay"
Group label "Task visibility":
5. tiny muted amber question glyph, "Resolve grouping"
6. tiny muted amber circular repair glyph, "Restore live updates"
About 36px row height. Task titles are the visual focus. These are example tasks, not actual live execution claims.

Lower detail, padded 24px, with this exact hierarchy:
small muted mono "LZ-103"
clear bold 23px heading "Test restart recovery"
a small chain-link icon then one quiet line: "Waiting on Persist submission identity"
a short readable objective with NO label: "Retry after a host restart returns the original task ID."
then a modest subheading "Done when"
two plain, unboxed, unchecked checklist lines:
"Fresh process returns the same task ID"
"Only one task remains in storage"
then whitespace, then two quiet collapsed disclosure rows:
"Details"
"Activity"
The Details disclosure contains all advanced information when opened; do not expose budgets, scope, workers, models, revisions, attempts, separate relation chips, evidence cards, action buttons or metadata grids in this image. Full details stay available through disclosure. No footer controls. Avoid decorative gradients, glows, heavy shadows or large rounded cards. One continuous flat charcoal surface around #19191d, near-white primary type, muted gray secondary type, a very restrained violet selection accent, sparse amber only for tasks needing attention. Consistent Linear-like rhythm and excellent typography. This is a focused product UI, not a presentation board.
scopeClarification: Panel defaults to its routed session; an explicit project view is the only broader task scope. Host context supplies session/project identity, so the mockup needs no global scope control.
